name: Phase Transformations
summary: Covers how and how fast phases form: nucleation, growth, solidification, precipitation, spinodal and martensitic transformations, and TTT/CCT diagrams.

topics.name: Classification of phase transformations: diffusional vs diffusionless, first vs second order
Homogeneous nucleation: critical radius and nucleation barrier
Growth kinetics: interface-controlled and diffusion-controlled growth
Overall transformation kinetics: the Johnson-Mehl-Avrami-Kolmogorov equation
Solidification: constitutional supercooling, planar/cellular/dendritic growth and eutectic growth
Precipitation from supersaturated solid solution: GP zones, transition phases and age hardening
Spinodal decomposition and the Cahn-Hilliard picture
Eutectoid transformations: pearlite and bainite formation
Martensitic transformations: crystallography, habit plane and athermal kinetics
